text: Shevchenko itself lies at an intersection of two routes leading into Pokrovsk.Russia will likely continue to make gains towards Pokrovsk whilst continuing to advance westwards to the south of the town Russian forces have highly likely intersected Velyka Novsilka's north-eastern logistics route, the T-05-18.In early December, Ukrainian forces reportedly regained control of the village of Novyi Komar, and continue to maintain one remaining supply route to Velyka Novsilka from the north
